statistics_on_sensor.title: Water statistics must be moved off the sensor

confirm.title: Delete the statistics of the former consumption sensor
confirm.description:
Earlier versions imported the water consumption history of contract **{contract_id}** under `{sensor_statistic_id}`. Home Assistant also compiled its own statistics for that sensor, which made the Energy dashboard show large negative and positive consumptions.

The history now lives in the external statistic `{statistic_id}` (select it as the water source of the Energy dashboard). This will delete the statistics of `{sensor_statistic_id}` and the sensor itself. The history is kept in `{statistic_id}`.
